visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with light brown hair and a blue hair clip sits on a light wood-textured floor wearing a white off-the-shoulder long-sleeve top and light blue jeans. She holds a French fry from a red and white KFC box while sitting in a modern living room with a beige sofa and white paneled walls. A large white text overlay appears at the top center. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up shot of the flooring surface where three distinct drops of thick red ketchup are splattered on the wood grain. No human characters are visible in this frame. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the glossy texture of the sauce against the matte floor. (3) The woman is seen accidentally knocking over a large red and white KFC bucket and a white soda cup. Fried chicken pieces tumble out and liquid splashes across the light-colored wood floor. She looks down with a surprised facial expression, her hands raised in a gesture of sudden shock. (4) The woman takes a large bite of a hamburger, and several crumbs and lettuce pieces fall from her mouth onto her white shirt and the floor. She has a concerned expression with squinted eyes. The background remains consistent with the minimalist, well-lit living room interior and contemporary furniture. (5) The woman kneels on the floor holding a dark blue microfiber cloth, wiping the sauce and food debris from the surface with a smooth, efficient motion. Her expression shifts to one of relief as the floor appears clean and streak-free. The camera focuses on the physical interaction between the cloth and the floor. (6) The woman sits cross-legged on the floor, smiling and gesturing with her hands while explaining product features. She touches the floor surface with her palms to emphasize its texture. Blue and white variety-style text boxes appear at the bottom of the frame to summarize her points. (7) A large grey hard-shell suitcase with four wheels is pulled across the flooring horizontally. The woman's lower legs and brown loafers are visible as she drags the heavy luggage to demonstrate durability. The camera angle is low, focusing on the wheels' contact with the scratch-resistant wood. (8) The woman lies down completely on the floor, rolling playfully from side to side to demonstrate comfort and safety. The camera pans across the expansive living room area, showing a large white rug and a dark coffee table. Red arrows and variety text overlays point to her body.
